run_sft_training_gpt_oss: run supervised fine-tuning on GPT-OSS model with MxFP4 quantization and a HuggingFace dataset
train_model_sft_trainer: train a causal language model using SFTTrainer with packing, deepspeed zero3, and flash attention
load_quantized_model: load a causal language model with Mxfp4Config quantization and custom attention implementation
parse_sft_cli_args: parse CLI arguments for SFT training using TrlParser with ScriptArguments, SFTConfig, and ModelConfig
save_and_push_model: save a trained model to disk and optionally push it to the HuggingFace model hub
